questions.title: PHOTOGRAPHY CLUB - Part 1

metadata.scenario:
You are a new member of a photography club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20 – 30 words.
What is your favorite time and place to take pictures?

questions.stem: You are a member of a photography club. You are talking to three other members in the photography club chat room. Talk to them using sentences. Use 30 – 40 words.

questions.prompt: Hi! Welcome to the club. What is your favorite photo?
questions.sample_answer: Hello! It’s great to talk to you. My favorite photo is of a waterfall in Cao Bang Province. I saw it last month at a friend’s house, and the breathtaking scenery left a strong impression on me.

questions.prompt: Hi! What kind of photos do you like to take?
questions.sample_answer: Hi! I like taking nature photos, especially sunsets, flowers, and trees. I also enjoy capturing happy moments with friends and interesting things I see during my travels.

questions.prompt: Is it reasonable to take pictures with the phone?
questions.sample_answer: Yes, it is reasonable to take pictures with a phone. It’s easy, convenient, and phone cameras today are very good for capturing everyday moments and beautiful scenes.
